name: TowerPro SG90
mpn: SG90 (Analog; a Digital version shares the body)
description: 9 g micro PWM hobby servo with POM plastic gears, the common choice for light robot joints and pan-tilt mounts.

specs.label: Speed
specs.value: 0.12 s/60° @ 4.8 V (Analog page); 0.1 s/60° (Digital page and configure table)

specs.label: Operating voltage
specs.value: 4.8 V (TowerPro staff reply on the Digital page: 4.8–6 V is fine)

specs.label: Travel
specs.value: About 150° unless a 180°/360° version is specified (TowerPro reply on the product page)

specs.label: Interface
specs.value: PWM, JR plug (fits JR and Futaba), 1 µs dead band, 25 cm lead

envelope.axes: x = case length (B), y = width (D), z = case height excl. output spline (C), from TowerPro's 'Product configure table'

features.label: Tab height from bottom (F)
features.value: 17 mm (bottom of case to the tab, per the key image)

notes: TowerPro publishes no CAD, no mechanical drawing and no datasheet PDF. Its /download/ page is empty. TowerPro lists two pages, SG90 Analog (https://towerpro.com.tw/product/sg90-analog/) and SG90 Digital (https://towerpro.com.tw/product/sg90-7/), with the same dimensions and configure table. The pages differ only in speed (0.12 vs 0.1 s/60°), and the Analog page's own configure table also says 0.1. The A–F mapping is my reading of the generic key image (docs/dim_key.jpg): A = overall height incl. spline, B = case length, C = height excl. spline, D = width, E = tab-to-tab, F = bottom to tab. Mount-critical values (tab hole pitch and diameter, shaft offset, spline teeth, screw sizes) are not published by TowerPro, so they are null; measure a genuine unit or use a community model. The common 'SG90 datasheet' PDFs online are reseller documents, not TowerPro's, so none was used. TowerPro warns that many SG90s sold on Amazon/eBay/Alibaba are counterfeits. The Amazon pick is sold by American Robotic Supply (claims to be a Tower Pro dealer; listing model number SG90A2); its title verified, but the page showed no buy box, so it may be unavailable.
